missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бык' is the masculine nominative subject of 'стоит'. 'На лугу' uses the prepositional to show location.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Быка' is animate masculine, so the accusative equals the genitive. 'Большого' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Быка' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express absence. 'У соседа' marks the possessor in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Быку' is the dative indirect object of 'дал'. 'Сена' is genitive after the quantity word 'много'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Перед быком' uses the instrumental after 'перед' to mean in front of. 'Испугался' is the reflexive past verb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О быке' uses the prepositional after 'о' for the topic. 'В рассказе' shows where the topic appears.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'три' the noun takes the genitive singular 'быка'. 'На поле' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Быки' is the nominative plural subject. 'Сильные' is the agreeing plural adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Быков' is animate, so the accusative plural equals the genitive plural. After 'двух' the animate noun takes this form.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Бык' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Огромный' and 'злой' are agreeing masculine adjectives joined by 'и'.
